misconception_description: Student believes that colons (:) are used for variable assignment.

solutions.generated_code:
program PanjangKataTerpanjang
kamus
  n, i, panjangMax, panjangSekarang : integer
  kata : string
algoritma
  input(n)
  panjangMax : 0
  for i <- 1 to n do
    input(kata)
    panjangSekarang : panjang(kata)
    if panjangSekarang > panjangMax then
      panjangMax : panjangSekarang
    endif
  endfor
  output(panjangMax)
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student replaced the assignment operator (=) with colons (:) in both variable assignments. They believe this is the correct syntax for assigning values to variables. This will cause a SyntaxError because Python interprets this as malformed type annotation syntax without an actual assignment. The student is confident this is correct, possibly confusing assignment syntax with type annotations, dictionary syntax, or other uses of colons in Python.
